name: Foam RC Glider Jet — Large
description: A large remote-control jet made of impact-resistant EPP foam, about 44 x 32 x 13 cm. It flies for about 15 minutes on a charge of about 30 minutes, with a remote range of about 300 m. The box holds the jet, remote, battery, propellers, USB charger and landing gear.
